notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Multiple fixes and community requested changes
notes.notes:
The last 24 hours have been really useful to identify issues with the game. Massive thank you to all the playtesters!

-Shift can no longer see player on X-Ray ability unless blocked by game objects
-General ability cooldown improvements and tweaks
-Added multiple new Spawn Locations for the Shift
-Masks no longer block the interaction on the large fusebox task
-Firefighter ability now drains the mana of the Shift (on the UI)
-New courtyard secret item added
-New sound for failing lockpicking stage
-Improvements to 3D audio and game mix
-Shift Music intensity gain tweaked to be smoother
-Adjusted Aura Glow on heroes for ease of visibility
-Removed distortion effect from shift focus

notes.title: Update V1.0.9 - Multiple bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here are the many updates done in the last 48 hours.  I may have missed a few out from this list as there was so many however, here you go :)

  - Added guidance to help players find the gears for the girls' bedroom task.
  - Removed the bug description from the cabinet's bathroom door.
  - Prevented players from scaling walls and jumping around.
  - Stopped task videos from repeating.
  - Adjusted the basement fusebox to enable the library door to open, ensuring the game can be completed.
  - Left tutorial cages open, except for the one containing the trapped hero.
  - Added a prevention method to the musical safebox to stop it from skipping tasks.
  - Added extra help messages when retrieving Enzo's violin and the fireplace statue.
  - Made the message on the potion more visible and easier to read.
  - Slightly adjusted the Shift's camera to minimise the visibility of the outside map.
  - Crowd control issues resolved
  - New Shift Controls reminder UI when playing shift (Top left corner)
  - New particle FX for gears in girl's bedroom to assist in finding items
  - Multiple FX firing issues on the fireplace exit
  - Library doors failsafe on the fireplace exit
  - Additional null checks on networking when leaving games
  - Graphical changes to library stairs
  - Player freezing issues removed
  - Font size increases on potion bottles
  - Sidebar fixed for potions task on client side (it wasn't appearing correctly)
  - Login feedback on the main menu account form
  - Shift no longer gets stuck in the attic exit
  - Shift collider adjusted to prevent seeing through walls (99%)
  - Black graphics loading into rooms minimised


There are still more and we're on it guys :)

Much love & Happy Playing....
[i][b]Team Futura![/b][/i]

notes.title: Bug fixes to firefighter & Controller info
notes.notes:
Small bug fixes to Firefighter movement.

[b]Please note, the game currently doesn't have full controller support.  Additional info can be seen on the initial splash screen.[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 Lobby Upgrade, Playfab Improvements
notes.notes: Various bug fixes to improve both performance and the user experience.  The primary change is that the lobby loadout bug has been resolved.  Additionally, playfab integration has hit stage two so you can now find hidden tapes and polaroids for the Book of Shadows.
